timing: before any new backbone generation or new candidate prediction/ranking
control_gate_amendment: Use native TCR variable-domain pose recovery, retaining full assay pMHC. All native pMHC contact residues retained; removed constant-region atoms are at least 34.44 A from pMHC. Full TCR run was stopped for resource cost, not biological failure.
scope_of_control_thresholds: Task-specific minimum recovery of a majority of known contact residue pairs and localization of interface residues. This is a geometry usability check, not an affinity or specificity calibration, and is not transferred as a universal binder score cutoff.
backbone_preselection_scope: Filter obvious off-peptide poses, severe backbone overlap, or broken fixed-target mappings before sequence generation; these values do not establish binding.
predicted_vs_generated_pose: Align by HLA groove CA1-180; retain at least half of generated binder-peptide CA residue pairs within 8 A and report binder CA RMSD. Majority-contact preservation is an operational check of retained design intent, not affinity.
